headline: Members discussed city manager duties, monthly finance reports, and council pay; no votes were taken.
summary: Members questioned an interim city manager and the mayor about the city manager's role, finance reporting, and the charter. Discussion covered monthly budget reports, council pay, and the city manager contract. No votes were recorded, and the next meeting will take up the roles of the mayor and city council.
discussion: City manager oversight: Members discussed how the council and mayor oversee the city manager, including annual reviews, goal setting, and removal provisions in the charter or contract.
Monthly financial reporting: Speakers said the charter should require regular budget and finance reports to the council, and one speaker proposed a public financial dashboard.
Council and mayor pay: Speakers said pay for elected officials is too low and should be set in the budget rather than the charter.
Staggered and longer terms: Members discussed whether two-year council terms are too short and whether staggered terms would give more continuity. Views on staggered terms differed.
Budget committee process: Members discussed whether to return budget review to the Finance Committee and whether the mayor should serve on the school board.
